name: embedded-device-auto-debug-mcp
description: Expose the embedded auto-debug workflow as MCP tools for AI agents.

interface.shortDescription: MCP tools for serial observation, control, evidence, and transfer.
interface.longDescription: Wrap the embedded device automation workflow as MCP tools so other AI agents can observe serial output, run checks, collect evidence, and pull structured session results from any local clone or installed copy.
defaultPrompt: Inspect available serial ports and tell me which device to debug.
Run a startup debug session on COM19 and summarize the evidence.
Collect a health report from the current embedded device session.
